title: 170-odd Q-cleared witnesses of UFOs at sensitive sites
summary: Jesse Michels tells of 170-odd Q-cleared witnesses of UFOs at sensitive sites, about undated at US nuclear sites, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: See see if the 170-odd Q cleared, you know, people seeing UFOs around our most sensitive sites, shutting them down in certain cases,

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that about 170 people holding a Q clearance, the top security clearance for work on US nuclear weapons, have reported seeing UFOs around the country's most sensitive nuclear sites. He says that in some cases these objects shut the sites down. If true, it would mean something unknown can interfere with America's nuclear arsenal.
